_notes: First-10-minutes cards (ui/tutorial_overlay.gd). Topics are acknowledged with the ack_tutorial command.

purge_preview.title: The Purge
lines: Every seventh night is the Purge. It is lawless: wild beasts and raiders roam, and anyone may fight.
You never have to fight. Walls, rations and a full garrison are a fine plan.
The Purge pays: Ashmarrow and spoils, rank, skill points. Staying out entirely means a lower ceiling.
A Warning arrives the day before. You will have time to prepare.

controls.title: Getting around
lines: Drag to walk. Use the action button or [E] beside plots, holdings and places.
The toolbar on the left opens BUILD, CRAFT and the JOURNAL.

journal.title: Your journal
lines: The JOURNAL lists quests. They are all optional and all doable alone.

companions.title: Companions
lines: Small creatures can follow you or work at a holding. Open PETS to feed and place them.
They help in peace, steady the garrison in the Purge, and never fight for you.
